About Uptime
In a time where doom-scrolling and limited
focus thrive, Uptime was founded with a
mission to bring learning and wellbeing to the
masses. Our team of experts curate the top
books, courses, documentaries, and podcasts
from the world's biggest Creators, and distil
the knowledge so that you can take away all
the key information in just 5 minutes.
Our Hack format is designed to be engaging,
with different options and features to suit you
and help you learn. Uptime also partners with
companies around the globe, allowing them
to leverage this unique format and create
their own content to share within their own
communities.
